scope: Documented target architecture and disposable R0 evidence; no production runtime exists.

threats.title: Cross-tenant access through API, RLS, jobs, cache, files, exports or AI retrieval
threats.threatSource: Authenticated tenant member or confused background process
existingControls: FORCE RLS contract proven in the disposable identity spike
gaps: No production API, job, cache, export, storage or AI retrieval path exists yet
requiredTests: BOLA tests for every resource path
detection: Cross-tenant invariant alerts without resource identifiers
threats.residualRisk: critical until each production surface passes negative isolation tests
threats.blockingGate: No affected capability can be enabled with a known cross-tenant path

threats.title: Account takeover through unsafe linking, recovery, sessions or privileged actions
threats.threatSource: Remote attacker with a compromised email or replayed recovery flow
existingControls: OIDC Authorization Code with PKCE target
Secure HttpOnly SameSite cookie, CSRF/origin, CORS and CSP targets
One-shot recovery and anti-enumeration proven in disposable evidence
gaps: No production edge, CSP, CSRF/CORS, cookie policy, IdP, email provider, DPA or session lifecycle is approved
requiredTests: CSP, XSS, CSRF, CORS, cookie and clickjacking tests
Recovery email, enumeration and revocation tests
detection: Rate and anomaly signals for recovery/linking
threats.residualRisk: critical until the real IdP and session lifecycle pass the R1 gate
threats.blockingGate: Identity cannot enter production without sandbox evidence and explicit IdP decision

threats.title: Malicious file, forged scan result or reusable grant exposes data or code execution
threats.threatSource: Authenticated uploader, compromised scanner or grant recipient
existingControls: Private quarantine and fail-closed scan contract
Hash/version/manifest contract proven with synthetic evidence
gaps: No cloud scanner, KMS, WORM policy, sandbox or production limits are approved
detection: Scan verdict and quarantine backlog metrics
Grant anomaly audit without filenames or tokens
threats.residualRisk: critical until a real storage and antimalware sandbox passes
threats.blockingGate: Only an exact clean verdict may publish a file; all other states remain unavailable

threats.title: Provider tampering, stale data or schema drift corrupts weather and safety decisions
threats.threatSource: Compromised provider, intermediary or changed upstream contract
gaps: Production channel authenticity, quota, durable replay store and provider contract are pending
threats.residualRisk: high until provider, channel and operational fallback are approved
threats.blockingGate: Stale, unverifiable or invalid data cannot drive a safety-sensitive recommendation

threats.title: Geometry, XML or NetCDF payload exhausts resources or corrupts spatial state
threats.threatSource: Authenticated user or compromised upstream data source
existingControls: Size, vertex, SRID and validity limits
DTD disabled and bounded parser fixtures
gaps: Production request quotas, process isolation and query timeouts are pending
threats.residualRisk: high until production limits and isolation are measured
threats.blockingGate: Invalid or over-budget geometry/parser input fails closed before persistence

threats.title: SSRF, redirect or replay reaches internal services or duplicates inbound effects
threats.threatSource: Remote user, malicious webhook sender or compromised provider configuration
existingControls: Target allow-list and signed/idempotent webhook policy
gaps: No production egress gateway, DNS/redirect policy or durable inbox exists
requiredTests: Webhook signature, timestamp, bounce retention and replay tests
threats.residualRisk: high until every adapter is constrained and tested
threats.blockingGate: No user-controlled arbitrary fetch; inbound effects require authenticated idempotent inbox processing

threats.title: Prompt injection or tool abuse exfiltrates data or produces an unsafe recommendation
threats.threatSource: Tenant user, document content, upstream payload or compromised model provider
gaps: No provider, retrieval implementation, eval dataset or kill-switch runtime exists
detection: Redacted eval regressions by use case
threats.residualRisk: critical until retrieval authorization, evals, red-team and kill switch pass
threats.blockingGate: No AI case can launch with write authority or unresolved critical red-team result

threats.title: Logs, traces or analytics leak identifiers, coordinates, documents or secrets
threats.threatSource: Developer mistake, over-broad telemetry collector or compromised operator
existingControls: No payloads and pseudonymized tenant target
gaps: No production SDK, collector, backend access or retention policy exists
detection: Automated sensitive-field scan over telemetry samples
threats.residualRisk: high until emitted telemetry is inspected end-to-end
threats.blockingGate: No production telemetry path may emit sensitive payloads or raw tenant/resource identifiers

threats.title: Privileged insider or support access abuses data and tampers with audit evidence
threats.threatSource: Administrator, operator, support user or stolen privileged session
existingControls: Support JIT is disabled and out of MVP scope
gaps: No production separation of duties, immutable audit store or incident channel exists
threats.residualRisk: critical until privileged paths and audit immutability are proven
threats.blockingGate: Sensitive administration/export requires reauthorization and immutable audit evidence

threats.title: Dependency, build or secret compromise introduces malicious artifacts or credential theft
threats.threatSource: Malicious package maintainer, compromised developer account or leaked secret
existingControls: No real secrets allowed in repository
gaps: No root product lockfiles, CI identity, provenance or artifact signing exists
threats.residualRisk: critical until a product pipeline enforces the gates
threats.blockingGate: High/critical vulnerabilities or exposed secrets block release unless formally accepted by authorized owners

threats.title: Ransomware, backup compromise or incomplete restore destroys integrity and availability
threats.threatSource: Compromised runtime/operator principal or destructive infrastructure failure
existingControls: Isolated local restore drill validates manifest/hash/linkage with synthetic evidence
gaps: Managed PITR, immutable backup, key recovery, region and representative-volume drill are unproven
threats.residualRisk: critical until managed backup and restore are demonstrated
threats.blockingGate: Production persistence requires a successful isolated restore of database, objects and audit evidence

threats.title: Retry, concurrency or out-of-order processing duplicates effects or silently loses history
threats.threatSource: Network retry, concurrent user, delayed worker or replayed event
existingControls: Confirmed facts must be rectified rather than overwritten
gaps: No production mutation, outbox/inbox or N/N-1 migration drill exists
threats.residualRisk: high until a real resource and persistence path pass the R1 tests
threats.blockingGate: A duplicate or stale command cannot create a second effect or overwrite a confirmed fact

threats.title: Unapproved processing, transfer, retention or restore violates privacy obligations
threats.threatSource: Product configuration, provider contract gap or operator error
existingControls: Provider gates require region, DPA and subprocessors
Legal hold precedes purge by contract
gaps: Q-054/Q-055/Q-058/Q-060, controller roles, retention periods, regions and DPA are unresolved
detection: Privacy request SLA and purge reconciliation
threats.residualRisk: high and conditionally unranked where legal context is absent
threats.blockingGate: VAL-LEG and provider approval are mandatory before affected production processing

threats.title: Abuse, provider failure or unbounded cost exhausts an online-only critical path
threats.threatSource: Anonymous/authenticated abuser, hot tenant or failed external provider
existingControls: Online-only scope with explicit degraded states
gaps: Real load, rural connectivity, budgets, provider quotas and alerts are unmeasured
detection: Rate-limit, quota, cost and dependency-health alerts
threats.residualRisk: high until representative load, cost and connectivity evidence replace synthetic assumptions
threats.blockingGate: A dependency failure must not fabricate data or corrupt core transactions; budget inputs missing produce NO-GO
